model StorageFinalizeJob @@map("app_storage_finalize_job"); /// TASK-2250: durable finalize queue for one uploaded attachment, modelled on WorkRoutingOutbox (dedupe key, attempts, lease, next attempt). Null means the default drive (SHAREPOINT_DRIVE_ID).; sharepoint_item_id: /// TASK-2352: the SharePoint item this job finalizes, pinned at enqueue. The worker reads and writes only this item, never the attachment's current pointer. A null here is read from `dedupeKey` (finalize-queue.ts `pinnedTarget`); a key that does not parse leaves the job unpinned.; metadata: /// SharePoint column values to write, built at upload time.
